name: Time clock
description: Start work, break, business trip and end of day: one tap from the Lock Screen or Shortcuts.
changes: Hours worked, break and status as Shortcuts values
schema: CREATE TABLE entries (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('work', 'break', 'trip', 'end')), at TEXT NOT NULL, place TEXT)

actions.title: Start work
actions.sql: INSERT INTO entries (kind, at, place) VALUES ('work', :today || ' ' || :time, NULL)
actions.query: WITH e AS (SELECT kind, at, coalesce(lead(at) OVER (ORDER BY at, rowid), CASE WHEN kind = 'end' THEN at ELSE datetime('now', 'localtime') END) AS nxt FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime')), m AS (SELECT kind, coalesce(sum(round((julianday(nxt) - julianday(at)) * 1440)), 0) AS n FROM e GROUP BY kind), t AS (SELECT CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind IN ('work', 'trip') THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS work, CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind = 'break' THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS brk FROM m), last AS (SELECT kind FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime') ORDER BY at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT kind FROM last) IS NULL THEN 'Not started' ELSE 'Running' END AS state, printf('%d:%02d', work / 60, work % 60) AS worked, printf('%d:%02d', brk / 60, brk % 60) AS paused FROM t
actions.when: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT coalesce((SELECT kind FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime') ORDER BY at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'none') AS k) WHERE k IN ('none', 'end', 'break')

card.query: WITH e AS (SELECT kind, at, coalesce(lead(at) OVER (ORDER BY at, rowid), CASE WHEN kind = 'end' THEN at ELSE datetime('now', 'localtime') END) AS nxt FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime')), m AS (SELECT kind, coalesce(sum(round((julianday(nxt) - julianday(at)) * 1440)), 0) AS n FROM e GROUP BY kind), t AS (SELECT CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind IN ('work', 'trip') THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS work, CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind = 'break' THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS brk FROM m), last AS (SELECT kind FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime') ORDER BY at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT kind FROM last) IS NULL THEN 'Not started' WHEN (SELECT kind FROM last) = 'end' THEN 'Done' ELSE 'Running' END AS state, printf('%d:%02d', work / 60, work % 60) AS worked, printf('%d:%02d', brk / 60, brk % 60) AS paused, work, brk FROM t

menu.title: {{title}}
menu.subtitle: Work {{worked}} · Break {{paused}}
menu.query: WITH e AS (SELECT kind, at, coalesce(lead(at) OVER (ORDER BY at, rowid), CASE WHEN kind = 'end' THEN at ELSE datetime('now', 'localtime') END) AS nxt FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime')), m AS (SELECT kind, coalesce(sum(round((julianday(nxt) - julianday(at)) * 1440)), 0) AS n FROM e GROUP BY kind), t AS (SELECT CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind IN ('work', 'trip') THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS work, CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind = 'break' THEN n END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS brk FROM m), last AS (SELECT kind, substr(at, 12, 5) AS hm FROM entries WHERE date(at) = date('now', 'localtime') ORDER BY at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE (SELECT kind FROM last) WHEN 'work' THEN 'Working since ' || (SELECT hm FROM last) WHEN 'trip' THEN 'On a business trip since ' || (SELECT hm FROM last) WHEN 'break' THEN 'On a break since ' || (SELECT hm FROM last) WHEN 'end' THEN 'Done at ' || (SELECT hm FROM last) ELSE 'Not started' END AS title, printf('%d:%02d', work / 60, work % 60) AS worked, printf('%d:%02d', brk / 60, brk % 60) AS paused FROM t
